#### Changed Content
```js
"use strict";
self["rspackHotUpdate"]("main", {
"./a.js"(module, __webpack_exports__, __webpack_require__) {
__webpack_require__.r(__webpack_exports__);
__webpack_require__.d(__webpack_exports__, {
  "default": () => (__rspack_default_export)
});

/* export default */ const __rspack_default_export = (__webpack_require__.hmrH(module.hot).data);


},
"./module.js"(__unused_rspack_module, __webpack_exports__, __webpack_require__) {
__webpack_require__.r(__webpack_exports__);
__webpack_require__.d(__webpack_exports__, {
  "default": () => (/* reexport safe */ _a__rspack_import_0["default"])
});
/* import */ var _a__rspack_import_0 = __webpack_require__("./a.js");




},

},function(__webpack_require__) {
// webpack/runtime/get_full_hash
(() => {
__webpack_require__.h = () => ("CURRENT_HASH")
})();
// webpack/runtime/hot_context
(() => {
var hotContextStateKey = "__rspack_hot_context__";
var hotContextDataKey = "__rspack_hot_context_data__";

__webpack_require__.hmrH = function (moduleHot) {
	var previousState = moduleHot[hotContextStateKey];
	if (previousState) return previousState.context;

	var state = {
		data: moduleHot.data && moduleHot.data[hotContextDataKey] || {},
		selfCallback: undefined,
		acceptCallbacks: []
	};

	var context = {
		get data() {
			return state.data;
		},
		accept: function (deps, callback, refresh) {
			if (deps === undefined) {
				if (!moduleHot._selfAccepted) moduleHot.accept();
				return;
			}
			if (typeof deps === "function") {
				if (!moduleHot._selfAccepted) moduleHot.accept();
				state.selfCallback = deps;
				return;
			}
			if (!Array.isArray(deps)) {
				state.acceptCallbacks.push({
					deps: [deps],
					callback: callback,
					refresh: refresh,
					single: true
				});
				return;
			}
			state.acceptCallbacks.push({
				deps: deps.slice(),
				callback: callback,
				refresh: refresh,
				single: false
			});
		},
		dispose: function (callback) {
			moduleHot.dispose(function () {
				callback(state.data);
			});
		}
	};

	state.context = context;
	Object.defineProperty(moduleHot, hotContextStateKey, {
		value: state
	});
	moduleHot.dispose(function (data) {
		Object.defineProperty(data, hotContextDataKey, {
			configurable: true,
			value: state.data
		});
	});
	return context;
};

})();

}
);
```
